title: Implement scan admission, idempotency and preflight
summary: Added a single permission-first scan admission boundary for manual, schedule and release commands with hashed idempotency, exact verification freshness, bounded SSRF-safe preflight, effective policy revalidation, weighted quota holds and PostgreSQL-serialized global/organization/project capacity. Scan, reservation, policy snapshot and outbox evidence commit atomically; Solid Queue dispatch is post-commit, quota-revalidated and recoverable by a bounded recurring sweep. Added stable HTML/JSON UI error contracts, an enabled dashboard action, immutable database provenance, public projections and operational documentation.
